security_audit.summary: All 18 static findings are false positives. remediation.issue: Static analysis misidentifies Markdown inline code as shell execution.
remediation.suggestion: Configure the scanner to ignore Markdown inline-code spans or distinguish documentation files from executable source before reporting command execution.

remediation.issue: Static analysis reports documented secret variable names as environment access.
remediation.suggestion: Treat variable names in configuration documentation as informational unless the file reads, embeds, or transmits a value.

content.value_statement: FastAPI backend documentation can be difficult to navigate when chat, retrieval, and service configuration are connected. This skill explains the endpoints, processing flow, utilities, and required configuration in one focused reference.
actual_capabilities: Explains the FastAPI application entry point and local development command.
Describes the POST /api/chat request, retrieval, prompt-building, and response flow.
Describes the POST /api/ask-selection purpose and selection-validation flow.
Identifies the documented configuration, helper, and model modules.
Lists the documented Gemini and Qdrant environment variables and their roles.
limitations: Documents only the architecture described in SKILL.md.
Does not implement endpoints, run the server, or modify source files.
Does not provide request schemas, authentication details, or error responses.
Does not include deployment, security hardening, or testing instructions.

use_cases.title: Orient a new backend developer
use_cases.description: Review the application entry point, endpoints, and supporting modules before making a backend change.

use_cases.title: Plan a client integration
use_cases.description: Understand the documented chat and selected-text API responsibilities before designing a client workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare local service configuration
use_cases.description: Identify the documented Gemini and Qdrant configuration variables needed for the backend services.

prompt_templates.title: Find the server entry point
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, explain where the FastAPI application starts and how the documentation says to run it locally.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the chat endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, summarize the purpose, input, processing steps, and output of POST /api/chat.

prompt_templates.title: Compare documented endpoints
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, compare POST /api/chat and POST /api/ask-selection. State when each endpoint is appropriate.

prompt_templates.title: Map service dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, create a concise implementation checklist for the documented FastAPI, Gemini, and Qdrant dependencies. Do not infer undocumented details.

output_examples.input: What happens when a request reaches the documented chat endpoint?
output: The backend receives a ChatRequest containing a query, history, and user context.
It embeds the query, searches Qdrant, builds a RAG prompt, and generates an agent response.
It returns a ChatResponse with an answer and contexts.
GEMINI_API_KEY supports the documented LLM and embedding service.
QDRANT_URL and QDRANT_API_KEY configure the documented vector database connection.

best_practices: Use the skill as a reference and verify implementation details in the source repository.
Keep credentials in environment variables and never place their values in prompts or documentation.
Confirm endpoint schemas and error behavior before building a production integration.
anti_patterns: Do not assume undocumented authentication, validation, or response fields.
Do not treat the documented local run command as a production deployment method.
Do not expose Gemini or Qdrant credential values in client-side code.

faq.question: What does this skill document?
faq.answer: It documents a FastAPI backend, its RAG-related endpoints, supporting modules, and named service configuration variables.

faq.question: Does this skill create a FastAPI application?
faq.answer: No. It is an architecture reference and does not generate or execute backend code.

faq.question: Which endpoint handles general chat?
faq.answer: The documented general chat endpoint is POST /api/chat.

faq.question: Which endpoint handles selected text?
faq.answer: The documented selected-text endpoint is POST /api/ask-selection.

faq.question: Which external services are mentioned?
faq.answer: The documentation mentions Gemini for LLM and embeddings, plus Qdrant for vector search.

faq.question: Does the skill provide security or deployment guidance?
faq.answer: No. It does not document authentication, deployment, production hardening, or complete secret-management procedures.
